body.rootCause: The new engine refuses unapproved scope and generic HEAD differences. The existing BUILD-3789fd85d0bbeb22-s1 has four passed tasks, but records commit 39bb4c53e. Git uniquely resolves it to 39bb4c53e48fb22959786feff3ad6c5ef0679a66, the identical object; new admission requires the full object ID. Approval of this proposal explicitly authorizes that metadata-only expansion via canonical audited content update, preserving task evidence, without claiming a new BUILD approval or clearing previous findings. No normalization has been applied yet. Acceptance will use current approved readiness and Claude qualification under bounded test opt-in, restore legacy selection afterward, and retain actual checkpoint/publication/usage evidence. Default activation, final current-Story code review and legacy removal remain separate.
